item.subject: science
item.stem:
Fatima copies the feeding diagram shown below from a Class 8 field booklet.

Is the diagram a food chain or a food web, and why?

options.A: A food chain, because any diagram with arrows between living things is called a food chain.
options.B: A food web, because more than one feeding path reaches the leopard.
options.C: A food chain, because grass is drawn at the bottom so there can be only one sequence.
options.D: Neither, because the labels are animal names rather than the word producer or consumer.

learn_by_solve.solve: which trophic levels is the leopard feeding? Required: D — third / and / fifth. A would need “second”, but the item needs “fifth”. B would need “third”, but the item needs “fifth”. C would need “fourth”, but the item needs “fifth”.

A.pathway: swapping the sibling term “second” for the required “fifth”

followup.stem: Option A. This row is “first / and / second”. Should the first listed feature be marked third or first?

options.A: the first listed feature should be third
options.B: the first listed feature should be first
options.C: the first listed feature is not used in this item
options.D: both third and first at once

followup.why: Option A marks the first listed feature as first; the keyed row marks it as third.

B.pathway: dropping a stated condition so “third” looked possible instead of “fifth”

followup.stem: Option B. This row is “second / and / third”. Should the first listed feature be marked third or second?

options.A: the first listed feature should be third
options.B: the first listed feature should be second
options.C: the first listed feature is not used in this item
options.D: both third and second at once

followup.why: Option B marks the first listed feature as second; the keyed row marks it as third.

C.pathway: swapping the sibling term “fourth” for the required “fifth”

followup.stem: Option C. This row is “second / and / fourth”. Should the first listed feature be marked third or second?

options.A: the first listed feature should be second
options.B: the first listed feature is not used in this item
options.C: both third and second at once
options.D: the first listed feature should be third

followup.why: Option C marks the first listed feature as second; the keyed row marks it as third.
